name: child stdio inherit writes straight to the parent output
source: import { spawn } from 'node:child_process'; function main(): void { console.log('before'); const child = spawn('echo', ['inherited'], { stdio: 'inherit' }); child.on('close', (code: any) => { console.log('closed', code, child.stdout === null, child.stderr === null, child.stdin === null); }); }
